assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single transparent pixel-art knockout sprite for an existing Unity JRPG. Input image: identity and art-style REFERENCE showing the same character in four attack frames; create a NEW separate asset. Primary request: the hero at zero HP is KNEELING ON THE GROUND WITH HEAD BOWED, defeated and exhausted. ONE SINGLE full-body sprite, three-quarter profile FACING LEFT, matching reference camera and exact recognizable character identity, chibi body proportions, detailed crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines and shading palette. Both knees folded onto the ground, torso slumped forward, shoulders low, chin lowered toward chest, eyes closed or hidden by downward hair, hands relaxed resting on thighs. The pose must read clearly as kneeling, with bent lower legs and boots behind, not crouching or standing. Keep head and torso same proportions as reference, do not enlarge the head. Show all knees, feet, cape and equipment within frame. Character is alive but incapacitated, no wounds, no blood, no skulls, no effects. Genuine transparent alpha around sprite, isolated centered, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no labels, no text, no extra characters, no animation frames. Preserve original colors rather than greying them out. Character Aren: spiky golden blond hair bowed forward, red scarf and dark red cape draped downward, tan tunic over dark brown leather, charcoal trousers and brown boots. Sword lowered and resting along his side, no attack motion.
